name: native-facts
instruction: Review the target file for invented city identity, bypassed native rules, or guessed native facts. Read root AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, and the relevant native prefab readers, classifiers, placement code, and callers. Prefab capabilities, road category and lanes, typed-network identity, specialized-industry roles, frontage requirements, and transit-stop identity should follow native data shared by the relevant read and write paths. Report name-substring or width-based guesses when an existing native fact determines that identity; identify the native source and the incorrect classification. Distinguish identity from legitimate geometric width used for drawing, clearance, or site search. Construction must use ordinary native validation and simulation-thread dispatch; report collision bypass, Anarchy/force behavior, UI-thread apply, or silent ground-to-grade-separated promotion with a concrete execution path. Fixed validation bounds backed by the actual engine or format contract can prevent unsupported operations. A gameplay heuristic, such as an assumed milestone, lane count, speed, service role, or production capacity, must not impersonate an authoritative native fact when the value is queryable. Planning targets and clearly described recommendations may still be heuristics. Missing native evidence should stay explicit rather than become a plausible value. Anchor findings to the target implementation or misleading claim; report no finding without the native contract and consequence.
